privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: Dakka Motors is a used car dealership in Hamura, Tokyo. This page says what happens to your information when you use this website. It is short because we do little with it.
privacy.collectBody: The form on a car's page asks for your name and your phone number, and records which car you were looking at. The find-a-car form asks the same and lets you add an email address and a description of what you are after. We use them to telephone you back, and for nothing else. There is no account to create. We do not sell them, and we do not pass them to anyone other than the services listed below that we use to run the shop.
privacy.adsBody: We sometimes advertise one car at a time on Facebook and Instagram. This site carries a Meta pixel, which tells Meta which pages of this site a visitor looked at and whether they went on to leave their number. That is how we tell whether an advertisement for a particular car was worth running.
privacy.adsBody2: Your name, email address and phone number are never sent to Meta. What it receives is the page you were on, the car's listing name, and the IP address and browser that every website you visit receives. Meta may connect that to an account you are signed in to and use it to choose which advertisements to show you.
privacy.adsOptOut: To stop this: turn off ad personalisation in your Facebook or Instagram settings, use a browser or extension that blocks trackers, or browse in private mode. Nothing on this site stops working if you do.
privacy.cookiesBody: This site sets one cookie, and only when you submit a form: it stops that form being submitted from another site. It follows you nowhere. Staff signing in to the management pages set a second one; it is not set for visitors.
privacy.storageBody: The site runs on Amazon Web Services in Tokyo and your details are stored there. Email is sent through Brevo. We keep an enquiry for as long as it is useful to the shop.
privacy.contactTitle: Ask us about any of this
privacy.contactBody: Call us on <1>{{phone}}</1>, or reply to any email we have sent you. If you want to know what we hold about you, or want it deleted, that is how to ask.
